parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human CB1 receptor (CHEMBL218) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL218 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
